body:
Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-13 06:22Z, from Opus3 #5255 on w-e1053ea93543). Evaluation 2 there failed C4, "the full gate passes on the exact landed tree", with "lacks a qualifying full-gate verification locator; gate results appear in notes only". Landing-time FULLs quoted in notes (test-9dcc68b2, combo84's FULL) are not registered verification on the closure claim.
Rule: before launching any closure check, read the item's criteria. If any criterion is bound to the full gate, run `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --input commit` in the claim's own named root at current clean master, instead of a focused run. One Central slot (COLD 24 GiB, about 40 min) then serves the whole item.
Batch member credit does not exist: the verification_bind decision is #[cfg(test)] only (src/engram_verification_bind.rs). Each root and claim needs its own registered run.
Do not reword such criteria to cite note-only gates; that loosens them and needs Greg's word.
